landing.title: Did your bank refund a failed payment late? It may owe you ₹100 for every day of delay.
landing.lead: Upload your bank statement. VAPAS finds failed transactions the bank reversed late, works out the compensation the RBI rules require, and helps you claim it.
promises: We never connect to your bank and never touch your money.
We never send anything to your bank or to RBI. You review and send every complaint yourself.
Your statement file is deleted within an hour of reading it.
Every amount comes with the exact RBI rule behind it.
steps: Download your statement from net banking (PDF, CSV or Excel).
Upload it. VAPAS reads every transaction and checks it against RBI's turnaround-time rules.
See what you may be owed, with the reason and the rule.
Approve a ready complaint letter and send it to your bank yourself.
VAPAS tracks the waiting period and reminds you before the last date to go to the RBI Ombudsman.
landing.rule: RBI circular DPSS.CO.PD No.629/02.01.014/2019-20 (20 September 2019) sets deadlines for reversing failed transactions and ₹100 per day of delay as compensation, to be paid by the bank on its own. Most people never receive it.

guide.title: How to download your statement
guide.lead: VAPAS needs the statement file from your bank. It never logs in to your bank for you.
general: Log in to your bank's official net banking website or app. Type the address yourself; do not use links from messages.
Open your savings or current account and find the account statement option.
Choose the last 12 months. Only transactions from the last 12 months can become claims.
Download as PDF, CSV or Excel. If the PDF has a password, keep it ready: you will type it during upload and VAPAS never stores it.
guide.bankNote: Menu names change from time to time and differ between the website and the app. If you cannot find the statement option, ask your bank's official customer care.
guide.otherBanks: Other banks: you can still upload. VAPAS will tell you if it cannot read the layout.

Narrations and reference numbers are stored encrypted with a key only for your account.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draft: Draft. This policy will be reviewed before the public pilot.

sections.p: VAPAS (Verified Automated Payment Audit System) is a free tool that reads bank statements you upload and finds refunds your bank reversed late. For your personal data, VAPAS is a Data Fiduciary under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
Your email, a hash of your password, the statements you upload, and the complaints you prepare. We never ask for your net banking login and never connect to your bank.
Only to find late reversals and similar items, calculate compensation under RBI rules, and help you prepare complaints. No advertising, no sale of data, no training of AI models on your data.

Statement files are deleted within an hour of reading. Narrations, reference numbers, findings and letters are encrypted with a key unique to your account. Database rules stop one user from reading another user's data. Statement text is never sent to an outside AI service.
Transactions are kept for 13 months from their date. Findings, complaints and letters are kept until you delete them or your account. Database backups are kept for at most 7 days.
You can download all your data, withdraw consent, and delete your account at any time from Settings. If you withdraw consent, we stop reading new statements.
If a data breach affects you, we will tell you and the Data Protection Board of India as the law requires.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.draft: Draft. These terms will be reviewed before the public pilot.
items: VAPAS is not legal advice and not a law firm. It points out items in your statement and prepares drafts based on published RBI rules. You decide whether and what to send.
VAPAS never contacts your bank or RBI and never files anything for you. Any compensation is paid by your bank directly into your account.
Findings can be wrong, for example if a statement is read incorrectly. Check every letter before you send it.
Upload only your own statements, or statements you have written permission to upload.
You can stop using VAPAS and delete your data at any time.
